newsitem.title: USA: Superior Telecom sets IPO price terms.
newsitem.headline: Superior Telecom sets IPO price terms.

text.p: Superior Telecom Inc has set an estimated price range for its proposed initial public offering at $15 to $17 a share, according to a regulatory filing.

The company will offer 6 million shares, making the IPO worth about $96 million based on a midpoint of the estimated pricing range. Furman Selz is the lead underwriter of the offering. Oppenheimer & Co and BT Securities Corp are also underwriters.

Superior Telecom, a unit of Alpine Group Inc, said in its filing it is the leading manufacturer of copper wire and cable products for the local loop segment of the telecommunications network in the United States. It has been profitable since 1994.
Alpine said it plans to retain a majority stake in Superior Telecom after the offering.
The deal is tentatively scheduled for the middle of October, according to Furman Selz.
